size_note: size_mm is the side of the black square only (not the white margin). Measure your prints and correct these values if the printer scaled them.
front_offset_note: front_offset_deg (robots only, default 0): robot heading = tag heading + this. 180 means the robot drives toward the tag's back edge. pipeline/go_to_point.py --check prints the value to use.

field.frame: Top-down from the overhead camera, blue half on the left. Origin at the top-left corner, x to the right, y down. field_xy_mm values are nominal: measure where each anchor's center actually sits and update them.

groups.anchor: Fixed field markers for the pixel-to-field mapping. Any 4 visible are enough, so the 2 center-line markers cover corners that robots block.
groups.robot: One per robot, flat on top. The marker's top edge (the FRONT arrow) points the way the robot drives forward.
groups.puck: One per puck, flat on top. Optional: pucks only need counting by side, so color detection may work better on small pucks.
groups.spare: Replacements for damaged markers. Do not put a spare in play while the marker it replaces is also in view.
groups.test: Size-test strip: hold it at the far end of the field to find the smallest size your camera can read.

calibration_board.note: Uses a different dictionary so the game detector never mistakes it for field markers. Measure the printed squares and use the measured sizes.
